subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Dot the I's and cross the T's

options.text: To make a bad situation worse.
To have no standard of beauty.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To do something carefully.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Dot the I's and cross the T's"** means to pay attention to every small detail in a task. (हर छोटे से छोटे विवरण पर ध्यान देना)

 
 
• **Example: **Before submitting the report, make sure to dot the I's and cross the T's.
 
 
 
• **"To do something carefully"** refers to performing a task with great precision and attention to detail. (सावधानीपूर्वक कुछ करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She always does her homework carefully to avoid any mistakes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To do something carefully**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To make a bad situation worse** (खराब स्थिति को और खराब करना): To take actions that exacerbate an already negative situation.

 
 
• **Example:** His careless remarks only made a bad situation worse.
 
 
 
• **To have no standard of beauty** (सौंदर्य का कोई मानक नहीं होना): To not adhere to conventional standards of beauty.
 
 
• **Example: **Art is subjective, and sometimes it seems to have no standard of beauty.
 
 
 
• **To complain about something** (किसी चीज के बारे में शिकायत करना): To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She tends to complain about the smallest inconveniences.
